list_child.name: lsregister
list_child.desc: Returns every building permit application currently held in the permits office register. This call is useful when staff need to work through the filings the office has on record.

decoys.name: lsarchive
decoys.desc: Returns every building permit application currently held in the closed records archive. This call is useful when staff need to answer a public records request about past filings.

decoys.name: lsdrafts
decoys.desc: Returns every building permit application currently saved as a draft in the online portal. This call is useful when staff need to help an applicant finish an incomplete filing.

decoys.name: lscounter
decoys.desc: Returns every building permit application currently waiting in the front counter queue. This call is useful when intake staff need to see which walk-in filers are next in line.

get_child.name: getpermit
get_child.desc: Returns the permit record for one building permit application identified by its id. Call this when you need the scope, phase and filing dates for a specific filing.

decoys.name: getplans
decoys.desc: Returns the plan set for one building permit application identified by its id. Call this when you need the submitted drawings and sheets for a specific filing.

decoys.name: getfees
decoys.desc: Returns the fee worksheet for one building permit application identified by its id. Call this when you need the assessed fees and payments for a specific filing.

decoys.name: getcard
decoys.desc: Returns the inspection card for one building permit application identified by its id. Call this when you need the signed inspection stops for a specific filing.

list_parent.name: lsappl
list_parent.desc: Returns every applicant account on file with the permits office, covering both individuals and firms. This is typically used to browse filers when staff need to look up who has applied for work.

decoys.name: lsowner
decoys.desc: Returns every applicant account listed on the county property owner rolls, covering both individuals and firms. This is typically used to browse filers when staff need to confirm who owns a parcel.

decoys.name: lslicense
decoys.desc: Returns every applicant account on the licensed contractor roster, covering both individuals and firms. This is typically used to browse filers when staff need to check a trade license.

decoys.name: lsbond
decoys.desc: Returns every applicant account on the surety bond register, covering both individuals and firms. This is typically used to browse filers when staff need to confirm a bond is posted.

get_parent.name: getappl
get_parent.desc: Returns the account profile for one applicant identified by their id. Use this when you need contact and filing details for a specific filer.

decoys.name: getlic
decoys.desc: Returns the contractor license for one applicant identified by their id. Use this when you need license class and expiry details for a specific filer.

decoys.name: getbond
decoys.desc: Returns the surety bond for one applicant identified by their id. Use this when you need bond amount and insurer details for a specific filer.

decoys.name: getledger
decoys.desc: Returns the fee ledger for one applicant identified by their id. Use this when you need balance and payment details for a specific filer.

delete_child.name: delpermit
delete_child.desc: Permanently removes a building permit application from the permits office register and cannot be reversed once it runs. This is used for filings that were entered in error or withdrawn by the applicant.

decoys.name: delplans
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a building permit application's plan set from the document store and cannot be reversed once it runs. This is used when drawings were uploaded against the wrong filing.

decoys.name: voidfees
decoys.desc: Permanently voids the assessed fees on a building permit application and cannot be reversed once it runs. This is used when a fee was calculated against the wrong declared valuation.

decoys.name: wipeinsp
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a building permit application's inspection results from the field log and cannot be reversed once it runs. This is used when inspectors logged visits against the wrong filing.
verbs: delete the field log entries for {obj}

set_enum.name: setcurphase
set_enum.desc: Updates a building permit's current phase to submitted, under review, approved, or denied depending on where it stands. This should be called whenever review status changes so the applicant-facing portal stays current.

decoys.name: setrecphase
decoys.desc: Updates a building permit's recommended phase to submitted, under review, approved, or denied depending on the plan reviewer's findings. This should be called whenever a reviewer finishes a pass so the supervisor sign-off queue stays current.

decoys.name: setreqphase
decoys.desc: Updates a building permit's requested phase to submitted, under review, approved, or denied depending on what the applicant has asked for. This should be called whenever a request is filed so the counter log stays current.

decoys.name: setprojphase
decoys.desc: Updates a building permit's projected phase to submitted, under review, approved, or denied depending on the review timeline. This should be called whenever deadlines shift so the monthly workload forecast stays current.

set_bool.name: flagrev
set_bool.desc: Marks a building permit application as flagged for additional review by senior staff. This is used whenever something about the filing looks unusual and warrants a second look.

decoys.name: flagexp
decoys.desc: Marks a building permit application as expedited for faster handling by plan check staff. This is used whenever a filing qualifies for the fast-track program and should move up the queue.

decoys.name: flagstop
decoys.desc: Marks a building permit application as under a stop-work order issued by field inspectors. This is used whenever work on site has gone beyond the approved plans and must halt.

decoys.name: flaghold
decoys.desc: Marks a building permit application as on hold for unpaid fees by the cashier's office. This is used whenever a payment bounces or an invoice goes past its due date.

set_ref.name: moveappl
set_ref.desc: Reassigns a building permit application to a different applicant's account in the system. This is typically needed when a filing was originally logged under the wrong name.

decoys.name: billappl
decoys.desc: Bills a building permit application's fees to a different applicant's account in the system. This is typically needed when a contractor pays on behalf of the property owner.

decoys.name: watchappl
decoys.desc: Subscribes a different applicant's account to status updates on a building permit application in the system. This is typically needed when a lender or neighbour asks to follow the filing.

decoys.name: agentappl
decoys.desc: Assigns a building permit application to a different applicant's account as authorized agent in the system. This is typically needed when an expediter handles the paperwork for the owner.

send.name: callappl
send.desc: Places a note to call an applicant regarding one of their building permit applications, logged as an outbound contact. This is the standard channel for updates that need a personal touch and a quick answer.
child_verbs: reach out to the applicant behind {obj}

decoys.name: mailappl
decoys.desc: Mails a formal letter to an applicant regarding one of their building permit applications, logged as an outbound contact. This is the standard channel for notices that need a paper trail and a postmark.
child_verbs: mail a letter to the applicant behind {obj}
send the applicant behind {obj} a formal letter

decoys.name: emailappl
decoys.desc: Sends an email to an applicant regarding one of their building permit applications, logged as an outbound contact. This is the standard channel for routine updates the applicant can answer at their convenience.
child_verbs: drop the applicant behind {obj} an email

decoys.name: textappl
decoys.desc: Sends a text message to an applicant regarding one of their building permit applications, logged as an outbound contact. This is the standard channel for short reminders about inspections and deadlines.
child_verbs: send the applicant behind {obj} a text

create.name: newpermit
create.desc: Creates a new building permit application for an applicant, with an optional scope of work and starting phase. This is used when a filing comes in at the counter or through the online portal.

decoys.name: newpreapp
decoys.desc: Creates a new pre-application meeting request for an applicant, with an optional scope of work and starting phase. This is used when a filer wants to talk a project through with staff before submitting.

decoys.name: newrevision
decoys.desc: Creates a new plan revision for an applicant, with an optional scope of work and starting phase. This is used when an approved project changes and needs revised drawings reviewed.

decoys.name: newtempuse
decoys.desc: Creates a new temporary use permit for an applicant, with an optional scope of work and starting phase. This is used when a filer needs a tent, trailer or event structure on site for a short time.

list_notes.name: lsnotes
list_notes.desc: Returns the notes attached to one building permit application. This is typically used to read back the remarks staff have left on the filing over time.

decoys.name: lscorr
decoys.desc: Returns the correction notices attached to one building permit application. This is typically used to read back the changes reviewers have asked the applicant to make.

decoys.name: lscond
decoys.desc: Returns the conditions of approval attached to one building permit application. This is typically used to read back the requirements the permit must meet at issuance.

decoys.name: lsinsp
decoys.desc: Returns the inspection results attached to one building permit application. This is typically used to read back what field inspectors found on each site visit.

add_note.name: addnote
add_note.desc: Attaches a new note to a building permit application, with an optional title. This is used to record remarks from staff about the filing as it moves through review.

decoys.name: addcorr
decoys.desc: Attaches a new correction notice to a building permit application, with an optional title. This is used to record a change the plan reviewer needs from the applicant.

decoys.name: addcond
decoys.desc: Attaches a new condition of approval to a building permit application, with an optional title. This is used to record a requirement the permit must meet at issuance.

decoys.name: addinsp
decoys.desc: Attaches a new inspection result to a building permit application, with an optional title. This is used to record what a field inspector found on a site visit.

update_note.name: editnote
update_note.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing note on a building permit application. This is used to correct or expand a staff remark after it has been saved.

decoys.name: editcorr
decoys.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing correction notice on a building permit application. This is used when a reviewer rewords a requested change after resubmittal.

decoys.name: editcond
decoys.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing condition of approval on a building permit application. This is used when the planning director amends a requirement.

decoys.name: editinsp
decoys.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing inspection result on a building permit application. This is used when an inspector corrects findings from a site visit.

delete_note.name: delnote
delete_note.desc: Permanently removes a note from a building permit application. The remark is erased from the permit file and cannot be reversed once it runs.

decoys.name: delcorr
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a correction notice from a building permit application. The requested change is erased from the permit file and cannot be reversed once it runs.

decoys.name: delcond
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a condition of approval from a building permit application. The requirement is erased from the permit file and cannot be reversed once it runs.

decoys.name: delinsp
decoys.desc: Permanently removes an inspection result from a building permit application. The site visit finding is erased from the permit file and cannot be reversed once it runs.

set_image.name: setimg
set_image.desc: Sets the image shown on a building permit application record. This is typically a photo of the site or structure taken at intake.

decoys.name: setsite
decoys.desc: Sets the site plan shown on a building permit application record. This is typically the parcel drawing with setbacks marked by the applicant.

decoys.name: setcard
decoys.desc: Sets the placard image shown on a building permit application record. This is typically the printed permit card posted at the job site.

decoys.name: setelev
decoys.desc: Sets the elevation drawing shown on a building permit application record. This is typically the front view of the structure from the plan set.

writer.name: writemsg
writer.desc: Writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the building permit applications it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: writerpt
decoys.desc: Writes a staff report from a brief, which states the findings in the reviewer's own words, and the building permit applications it should cover. It returns the finished report.

decoys.name: writenotice
decoys.desc: Writes a public hearing notice from a brief, which states the agenda item in the planner's own words, and the building permit applications it should list. It returns the finished notice.

decoys.name: writememo
decoys.desc: Writes a council memo from a brief, which states the issue in the director's own words, and the building permit applications it should cite. It returns the finished memo.

image.name: genimg
image.desc: Generates an image from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: genmodel
decoys.desc: Generates a 3D massing model from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: findphoto
decoys.desc: Finds a matching photo in the site photo archive for a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the match.

decoys.name: genvideo
decoys.desc: Generates a short video walkthrough from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

search.name: searchdocs
search.desc: Searches the help docs and knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how the permit system works.

decoys.name: searchcode
decoys.desc: Searches the municipal building code with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up a construction requirement.

decoys.name: searchzoning
decoys.desc: Searches the zoning ordinance with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up a setback or permitted use rule.

decoys.name: searchminutes
decoys.desc: Searches the planning commission minutes with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how a past case was decided.
